info.comment: Flat vector food product: briefing broth. A white bowl of amber broth #C9853A with two simple gray steam chevrons above, navy napkin underneath. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, no text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges. Palette: navy #1B3A6B, blue #2F6FED, amber, white, gray.
